audit.why: 49.62% over 266 games. Pantheon owns 1-5, Qiyana takes 6 and first item (terrain R + lethality burst), Pantheon returns at two items. Content win[] matches the packet; full sides were blanket 'Skill'.
Spikes correct in substance: L2 W-Q all-in, her 6-9 terrain-R window, her first-item fog burst, his two-item re-tilt. Only the ult's name was wrong (see point 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Her R was called 'Edge of Ixtal' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[0] — Edge of Ixtal is her element-enchanted Q; the R is Supreme Display of Talent (120s flat). 'Stun-execute' claim softened: her R stuns and bursts but has no execute per the kit. 10 fields misgendered her; cooldowns field had no digits; dos/donts bodies pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Elemental Wrath/Edge of Ixtal, E Audacity (11/10/9/8/7s stick dash), R Supreme Display of Talent (120s, knockup/stun off detonated terrain, projectile). Her Q and R can cancel Pantheon's E channel (missingInteractions).
